slides.label: Interface comparison exercise
slides.source_text: Optional reference · Back to the talk In practice Run the same read through both interfaces Task: retrieve the invoice ticket and its acceptance cases. Hold data, access scope and requested output constant. For CLI and MCP, record: correctness; calls; failures; tokens; elapsed time Repeat after warm-up; report missing measurements. This is an experiment design, not a completed case study.
